properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] VMs for DNS: Disk Encryption Required
properties.description: Denies deployment of virtual machines without disk encryption enabled. FedRAMP High requires protection of information at rest (SC-28). DNS VMs handle sensitive DNS query data and must have Azure Disk Encryption (ADE) or host-based encryption enabled to protect OS and data disks with FIPS 140-2 validated cryptographic modules.

metadata.fips140CertRef: Platform module — Azure Disk Encryption uses BitLocker (FIPS 140-2 validated)

metadata.description: Deny: Block VM deployment without disk encryption. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
